tag: Sprint 14 Task E, F117 (F114 cloud read)

paper-aims-full-model-and-ga: Section I, p.2: the paper states its two aims in its own words; the quotes match the passage.
hom-setup-definition: Section II.A, Fig. 1, p.2: the paper defines the HOM-based QOCT measurement and the dip in C(tau) in its own words.
transfer-matrix-lossless-interface-model: Section II.A, Eqs. (1)-(6), pp.2-3: the paper defines its lossless-interface model, the four constraints, r_sample=-C/D and H(omega)=-C/D.
weak-dispersion-approximation: Section II.A, p.3: the passage states the not-highly-dispersive condition (dn/domega << n/omega, symbol lost in text layer) and phi_k=omega*tau_k. A stated model assumption.
single-layer-echo-expansion: Section II.A, Eq. (7), p.3: the single-layer H(omega) is derived from Eqs. (4)-(6) and expanded; the echo term at 2T is shown in the series and explained in the text. Short algebraic derivation in the paper.
spdc-state-and-jsi-gaussian: Section II.B, Eqs. (8),(12), pp.3-4: the paper states its SPDC state, symmetric f assumption and Gaussian JSI (citing [15]) as its model inputs.
pulsed-pump-suppresses-artifacts: Section II.B, p.4-5: for T >> tau_d the paper shows exp[-(mT/tau_d)^2/2] -> 0, so V_kl -> 0 and Gamma0 reduces; this follows directly from Eq. (14). The inequality symbol is lost in the quote but the passage states it. Also cited to [15].
ga-fitness-function-definition: Section II.C, p.6: the paper defines its fitness as the mean absolute error between C_exp and C_ret.
ga-parameter-count-6n-minus-5: Section II.C p.6 and Supplement p.12: a short counting derivation (8 real parameters per interface, 4 constraints, last interface one, plus 2(N-1)) gives 6N-5, shown in full in the Supplement.
experiment-source-and-detection-setup: Section III.A pp.6-7 and Section IV p.10: the paper states the laser, BBO crystal, filter, detectors, coincidence window, 1 um steps and 200 kHz linewidth.
experiment-samples-gold-coated-glass: Section III.A, p.7: the paper states the glass index, gold coatings, nominal reflectivities and the four-interface treatment of the air gap (R34=0.95 is in the passage).
nominal-reflectivity-uncertainty: Section III.A, p.7: the paper states the 0.5 nm tolerance and the below 4.3% reflectivity error of its own nominal values.
ga-layer-count-search-procedure: Section III.B, pp.7-8: the paper states the increasing-N search, the fitness figure of merit, N_best, the first N-1 reflectivities set, and that this is proof of principle.
ga-fit-assumes-monochromatic-pump: Section III.B, p.8: the paper states the fit assumes a monochromatic pump and pairs at 808 nm with 40 nm width.
ga-given-reflectivities-leave-one-free: Section III.B, p.8: the paper states which reflectivities it gave the algorithm and that only the last is left to find.
supp-noise-limits-direct-solution: Supplement pp.12-13: the paper states that solving the coupled equations may be impractical and that with noise unambiguous determination will most likely not occur.
device-triply-resonant-z-cut-pplN-micror: Introduction p.1: the paper describes its own device (triply resonant Z-cut PPLN microring, fundamental modes, d33). Verbatim in context.
device-fabrication-geometry: Device Design and Fabrication, p.2: poling period 3.85 um, 1.6 um width, 55 um radius, 700 nm LN on 2 um SiO2 are stated.
device-etch-and-coupler: Device Design and Fabrication, p.2: etch depth, sidewall angle and pulley coupler dimensions are stated; 90% and 75% are the design targets as the value says.
hamiltonian-and-g-definition: Device Design and Fabrication, Eq. (1), p.1: the paper writes the Hamiltonian and defines g in words.
pair-source-detection-chain: Photon-Pair Generation, p.2: the pump mode, 80 dB long-pass, 0.8 nm DWDM and SNSPD specs are stated.
pair-source-timing-and-loss: Photon-Pair Generation, pp.2-3: 46 ps system resolution and about 10 dB loss per channel are stated for its own system.
pgr-and-brightness-definitions: Pair Generation Rate and Brightness, p.3: PGR=N1N2/N12, the wavelengths and B=PGR/Pp are stated as the paper's method.
car-definition-and-window: CAR section, p.3: the CAR formula and the 200 ps window (cavity lifetime about 80 ps) are stated.
heralded-g2-method: Heralded Single-Photon Generation, p.4: the heralding wavelengths, 50/50 splitter, 200 ps window, 300 s period and N123N1/N12N13 formula are stated.
ma2023-pair-rate-estimator: Photon correlation, p.4: both first-order estimators PSI=NS NI/NSI and PSSII=NSS NII/NSSII are stated as the paper's method.
ma2023-device-geometry: Device Calibration and Experiment Setup, pp.1-2: 600 nm LN on 2 um SiO2, 1.6 um top width, 80 um radius, pulley coupler are stated.
ma2023-effective-hamiltonian: Eq. 1, p.2: the paper states its effective Hamiltonian and defines the operators and g.
ma2023-pump-and-cavity-modes: Device Calibration, pp.2-3: 300 ps pulses at 10 MHz, 776.96 nm visible mode of 1.14 GHz, signal and idler at 1551.85 and 1555.93 nm of 1.68 GHz are stated.
ma2023-losses-and-detectors: Device Calibration, pp.2-3: coupling losses, detector efficiencies, dark counts and total channel losses are stated as the paper's own calibration.
ma2023-filters: Device Calibration, p.3: the 80 dB, 0.5 dB long-pass filter and the 1.6 nm, about 0.3 dB DWDM filters are stated.
ma2023-thermal-distribution-definition: Photon Number Statistics, p.3: the paper states the single-mode thermal distribution P(n) as the reference it compares its data to; it is the model adopted in the analysis. Standard formula, stated not derived.
ma2023-car-table-method: Photon correlation, Table I, pp.4-5: the paper defines coincidence (same 400 ps slot) and accidental (slot 100 ns apart) counts, 120 s acquisition, about 1.1 uW.
ma2023-limit-ambient-dark-counts-neglect: Photon correlation, p.4: the paper states that its joint-state calculation neglects detector dark counts and ambient photons (about 100 Hz).

theory_low.echo-induced-artifact-types: Section II.A, p.3: a 'Note that' remark with no derivation at that point; the echo-artifact types are shown only by the numerical Fig. 3 labels. Not proved as stated.
theory_low.cw-interferogram-full-expression: Section II.B, Eqs. (13)-(15), Fig. 2, p.4: the closed form is obtained by substitution with no derivation shown; the quotes carry only the Fig. 2 simulation description (cT=200 um). A simulation outcome.
theory_low.echoes-survive-pulsed-pump: Section II.B, Fig. 3, p.5: a numerical result for a two-layer sample, plus the authors' interpretation that small echoes matter. A simulation outcome.
theory_low.supp-constraint-counting-noiseless-needs: Supplement p.12: an informal feature-counting argument (3, 5, 7 constraints); independence of the equations and solvability are not shown, and the text says only 'may be in a position'. Not a proof.
theory_low.ma2023-single-photon-coupling-g: Device Calibration, Eq. 2, p.2: a calculated value (2.98 MHz) from a formula taken from earlier work [14]; the inputs (d_eff, zeta, V_eff) are not given here, so it is not proved or checkable in this paper.
